inputs.topic: The South Sea Bubble Forensic Collapse

output.title: The £100,000,000 Illusion: How Isaac Newton Lost a Fortune

scenes.title: Cold Strike
scenes.narration: In the spring of 1720, the British Empire mortgaged its national debt to a trading company that owned no ships.

scenes.title: False Narrative
scenes.narration: Brokers promised endless South American gold, inflating stock by 800% in six months.

scenes.title: Forensic Paper Trail
scenes.narration: Parliamentary records reveal insiders began liquidating their positions in August.

scenes.title: Smoking Gun
scenes.narration: The bubble burst overnight. Sir Isaac Newton dumped his stock, having lost £20,000.

scenes.title: Modern Mirror
scenes.narration: Three centuries later, every liquidity trap still follows the exact South Sea blueprint.
